name: ship-your-site
displayName: Ship your site: domain, Netlify, DNS, HTTPS
description: Free step-by-step walkthrough and agent skill to take a local site live on your own domain with Netlify: deploy, make public, buy a domain, DNS, HTTPS, verify. By unblck.me.

walkthroughs.title: Ship your site
walkthroughs.description: From localhost to a live, public site on your own domain: Netlify deploy, domain, DNS, HTTPS, verified. By unblck.me.

steps.title: Let your AI agent guide you
steps.description: Ask your agent to **ship this site** and it follows the guide one step at a time, asking before any purchase or account action.

steps.title: Step 0: Make sure you have something deployable
steps.description: Find your build command and output folder (`dist`, `build`, `out`…), check that `index.html` is at its root, and keep secrets out of it.

steps.title: Step 1: Create a Netlify account
steps.description:
Sign up for the free plan and learn how credits work, so you never get charged or paused by surprise.
[Open Netlify sign-up](https://app.netlify.com/signup)

steps.title: Step 2: Deploy to a *.netlify.app URL
steps.description: Pick **drag and drop**, the **Netlify CLI**, or **Git**. Add a `_redirects` rewrite if your app uses client-side routing.

steps.title: Step 3: Make the project public
steps.description: Teams created on or after July 28, 2026 make projects **private by default**. Click **Make public**, then test in an incognito window.

steps.title: Step 4: Buy a domain
steps.description: Compare **renewal price**, WHOIS privacy and DNS control. Netlify, Cloudflare Registrar and retail registrars each have trade-offs.

steps.title: Step 5: Add the domain to your Netlify project
steps.description: **Domain management → Add a domain you already own**. Choose apex or `www` as primary and open **Pending DNS verification**.

steps.title: Step 6: Point DNS at Netlify
steps.description: **6A** switch nameservers to Netlify DNS, or **6B** add records at your current DNS host. Watch for MX records, DNSSEC and Cloudflare's proxy.

steps.title: Step 7: HTTPS certificate
steps.description: Netlify issues a free Let's Encrypt certificate once DNS resolves. Here's how to check it and fix a stuck one.

steps.title: Step 8: Verify from outside your own machine
steps.description: Run the `dig` and `curl` checks, then open the site in incognito and on your phone with Wi-Fi off. Padlock + real site = live.

steps.title: Common failures and fixes
steps.description:
Login wall, 404 on refresh, parking page, stuck DNS verification, certificate errors, lost email: symptoms, causes and fixes.
[Read the full guide](https://github.com/unblck/ship-your-site/blob/main/skills/ship-your-site/references/GUIDE.md)
